name: Philippines
warningSystem: PAGASA issues Tropical Cyclone Wind Signals 1–5 and color-coded rainfall warnings (yellow, orange, red). PHIVOLCS issues earthquake and tsunami warnings. Your barangay will announce pre-emptive or forced evacuation.

agencies.name: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
agencies.description: Coordinates national disaster response through the Office of Civil Defense. Your city/municipal DRRM office and barangay run local evacuation.

agencies.name: PAGASA (weather bureau)
agencies.description: Official typhoon signals, rainfall and flood warnings.

agencies.name: PHIVOLCS
agencies.description: Earthquake, tsunami and volcano monitoring and warnings.

agencies.name: Department of Social Welfare and Development
agencies.description: Runs evacuation center relief, family food packs and crisis assistance.

agencies.name: Philippine Red Cross
agencies.description: Rescue, first aid, blood, relief goods and welfare desks in evacuation centers. Hotline 143.

programs.name: Family Food Packs
programs.description: Rice, canned goods and coffee/cereal for displaced families, distributed in evacuation centers and affected barangays.
programs.howToApply: Register at your evacuation center or barangay hall. Keep your Disaster Assistance Family Access Card (DAFAC) if you are given one.

programs.name: Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS)
programs.description: Cash for medical, burial, food or transport needs after a crisis.
programs.howToApply: Go to a DSWD field office or crisis intervention unit with a valid ID and supporting documents (e.g. medical certificate).

programs.name: Emergency Shelter Assistance
programs.description: Cash or materials for families whose houses were partially or totally damaged.
programs.howToApply: Report damage to your barangay so it is recorded in the damage assessment list.

programs.name: Red Cross health and welfare desk
programs.description: First aid, maternal and child health support, psychosocial support and family reunification.
programs.howToApply: Visit the Red Cross welfare desk at the evacuation center or call 143.
